_metadata.resource_title: Curiosity's Proposed Path Up Mount Sharp (Aeolis Mons)
_metadata.landing_site: Bradbury Landing, Gale Crater (-4.5895 S, 137.4417 E)
_metadata.description: Annotated waypoints, elevation profiles, and route terrain hazards for Curiosity's ascent of lower Mount Sharp.

route_overview.exploration_zone: Lower strata (Pahrump Hills up to Gediz Vallis and Boxwork structures)
route_overview.primary_objective: Determine the transition from warm, wet habitable lake environments (clays) to dry, hyper-acidic desert conditions (sulfates).

waypoints.name: Bradbury Landing
waypoints.scientific_target: Landing touchdown verification and system checkout

waypoints.name: Yellowknife Bay
waypoints.scientific_target: Discovery of ancient habitable freshwater lake with C, H, N, O, P, S

waypoints.name: Pahrump Hills (Mount Sharp Base)
waypoints.terrain_type: Murray formation mudstone with mineral veins
waypoints.scientific_target: First basal unit of Mount Sharp

waypoints.name: Bagnold Dunes (Oasis)
waypoints.terrain_type: Active dark basaltic sand dunes with ripple fields
waypoints.scientific_target: First in-situ investigation of active extraterrestrial dune field

waypoints.name: Vera Rubin Ridge
waypoints.hazard_level: High (steep inclines, wheel puncture risk from ventifacts)
waypoints.scientific_target: Strong orbital hematite signature and iron oxide crystallization

waypoints.name: Glen Torridon (Clay-Bearing Unit)
waypoints.scientific_target: Highest concentration of clay minerals found in Gale Crater

waypoints.name: Greenheugh Pediment
waypoints.terrain_type: Capping sandstone unconformity, extreme steep incline
waypoints.hazard_level: Severe (steepest climb tackled by Curiosity: 31 deg tilt)
waypoints.scientific_target: Erosional boundary and major planetary timescale transition

waypoints.name: Sulfate-Bearing Unit
waypoints.terrain_type: Magnesium and calcium sulfate layers, polyhydrated minerals
waypoints.scientific_target: Drying of ancient Mars and transition to acidic hyper-saline waters

waypoints.name: Gediz Vallis Channel
waypoints.terrain_type: Debris flow ridge, large boulders transported by water/mud floods
waypoints.scientific_target: Last major wet events and violent flash floods on Mount Sharp
